title: Predicting patients with septic shock and sepsis through analyzing whole-blood expression of NK cell-related hub genes using an advanced machine learning framework.
summary: A learned six-gene SepxFindeR model distinguished sepsis from septic shock across datasets and was checked with newly recruited RT-qPCR samples. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: LDA, risk scores and LASSO ensemble combine six hub genes; four GEO cohorts and recruited clinical RT-qPCR samples test discrimination.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Specific sepsis-stage classification is reported; small recruited validation is preliminary and does not establish improved outcomes or deployment.
